masterpieces.title: Ikbar Barbershop
masterpieces.subtitle: Flagship digital storefront
masterpieces.summary: A modern grooming platform with a clear service catalogue, transparent pricing, and a fast journey from first impression to booking.
masterpieces.technicalReportMdx:
## The brief
Translate a modern barbershop into a digital storefront: a clean, masculine visual identity, clear services and prices, and navigation designed for mobile customers.

## The experience
The storefront brings the brand, service catalogue, and customer journey into one public-facing experience. Its companion customizer gives the owner a separate place to maintain the website.

## The system boundary
This is the customer-facing half of the Ikbar ecosystem. The management dashboard is presented as a separate project below. The PRD describes the product relationship; infrastructure and performance measurements are not supplied.

## Design focus
Make the services easy to compare and the next action easy to find. Keep the visual character consistent across small and large screens.

masterpieces.title: Ikbar Autonomous CMS
masterpieces.subtitle: Self-service website customizer
masterpieces.summary: A custom control panel that lets the barbershop owner manage content, update services, and shape the storefront without editing code.
masterpieces.technicalReportMdx:
## The brief
Give the barbershop owner control over everyday website changes without a recurring developer handoff.

## The management experience
The custom dashboard is designed for editing content, updating services, and adjusting the appearance of the main website. These capabilities are described in the project brief.

## The product relationship
The dashboard and public storefront form a connected ecosystem: one serves customers, while the other supports the business owner. Specific database, authentication, and deployment internals are not documented in the supplied PRD.

## Engineering focus
Make content controls understandable to a non-developer. Keep editing and public browsing as separate experiences while preserving a consistent brand.

masterpieces.title: Dzikri Mount Guide
masterpieces.subtitle: Expedition & mountaineering platform
masterpieces.summary: An expedition platform that brings mountain routes, logistics, and guide profiles together before the first step of the journey.
masterpieces.technicalReportMdx:
## The brief
Build an informative and immersive digital home for mountain guiding and expeditions, covering routes, preparation, and guide profiles.

## The experience
Route information, logistics, and people are the core of the story. The interface helps visitors understand what a mountain journey involves before making plans.

## Design focus
Combine the atmosphere of the outdoors with practical information. The goal is a clear reading experience across desktop and mobile, without hiding essential preparation details.

## Preview note
The live site prevents embedding in another website. This portfolio provides a captured screenshot and a direct link so the full experience remains accessible.
